summary_en: Gerbera Holdings tender offer for METALART common stock concluded 28 Jul 2026. 1,825,640 shares tendered (63.8% of 2,862,640 ex-treasury shares outstanding as of 31 Mar 2026), excluding 1,037,000 shares held by Daihatsu. Minimum acceptance threshold 849,600 shares; no upper limit set. Fractional shares included.
title_en: Notice regarding results of public tender offer for ordinary shares of METALART CORPORATION by Gerbera Holdings Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: Gerbera Holdings Co., Ltd. conducted a public tender offer for the ordinary shares of METALART CORPORATION (TSE Standard Market, code 5644), which commenced on 15 May 2026 and concluded on 28 July 2026. The offer targeted up to 1,825,640 shares, representing 63.8% of the 2,862,640 shares outstanding as of 31 March 2026 (after excluding 294,742 treasury shares held by METALART and 1,037,000 shares held by Daihatsu Industrial Co., Ltd.). The tender had a minimum acceptance threshold of 849,600 shares; no maximum limit was set. Fractional shares were included in the offer. The filing is a results notice from the offeror reporting completion of the tender.
